articles.title: McDonald’s Japan Confirms Data Breach – Customer Information and Location Data Exposed
articles.summary:
McDonald’s Japan has confirmed that a third party gained unauthorized access to customer information stored in the database behind its official mobile app. In a November 20, 2026, breach notice, the company said the affected records included product purchase histories, internal customer management IDs, IP addresses, and location data from mobile devices used when it […]

articles.title: Critical VMware ESX Flaws Let Remote Attackers Execute Malicious Code on Virtualization Hosts
articles.summary:
Broadcom has disclosed 23 VMware vulnerabilities, including two critical flaws that could let attackers run code directly on ESX hosts and a third that could let them access vCenter without signing in. The Broadcom security advisory, VMSA-2026-0011, was published on November 24. It says the flaws were privately reported and does not report active exploitation. […]

articles.title: Hackers Deploy ZQAgent Backdoor to Run Malicious Commands and Access Files on Linux Servers
articles.summary:
A new Linux backdoor called ZQAgent is giving attackers a long-term foothold on compromised servers. It can run commands, move through folders, read files and open network tunnels. It also hides itself to look like a normal system process. The malware was dropped by ARTEX, an AI-driven hacking framework. Most ARTEX intrusions are quick smash-and-grab […]

articles.title: Critical ASP.NET AntiCsrf Flaw Exploited in Attacks by triggering a web redirect on vulnerable apps
articles.summary:

articles.summary:

articles.title: Hackers Bypass Alpine Linux SSH Authentication Using Just a 257-Byte Password
articles.summary:
A flaw in OpenSSH lets remote attackers sign in to certain Alpine Linux accounts without knowing a valid password or holding an SSH key. The vulnerability, tracked as CVE-2026-123158 and known as SSHole, affects unpatched servers that use the musl C library, run without Pluggable Authentication Modules (PAM), and allow SSH password logins. articles.title: Hackers Bypass MFA Through Phone Scams to Access Microsoft 365, OneDrive and SharePoint Data
articles.summary:

articles.title: Critical Google Chrome Flaw Could Let Hackers Execute Malicious Code Outside Browser Sandbox
